# HappyPix (https://happypix.in)

> Every Pixel is a Happy Moment. HappyPix is the all-in-one photo booth software, hardware, and operator CRM platform for event planners, wedding photographers, venue owners, and photo booth rental businesses across India and Australia.

## Core Capabilities
- **Booth Kiosk App (Android, iPad, Windows):** Live camera preview, customizable start screen branding, multi-slot print layouts (strips, 4x6, grids), photo filters, stickers, digital signatures, AI background removal, instant dye-sub printing (~12 seconds), and Razorpay/UPI pay-per-print checkout.
- **24-Hour Private QR Digital Copies:** Every booth session generates a private QR code on the completion screen so guests can download their composite strip and individual frames immediately without installing an app. Links expire automatically after 24 hours.
- **Operator CRM & Cloud Dashboard:** Manage events, connected booth devices, custom templates, AI cutout studio, guest galleries with consent tracking, coupon codes, support tickets, and live event revenue in one place.
- **Hardware Compatibility:** Native support for DNP dye-sublimation printers (DS620A, DS820A, DS-RX1HS, QW410, DS40, DS80) and Canon EOS cameras over USB tethering and Canon CCAPI (EOS R50, R100, R10, R8, R6 Mark II, 200D II, 90D, M50 Mark II).
